name: Fen Bhata
personality: drawn to places he's told to avoid
quick with his hands, slower with words
more comfortable with wood and terrain than with people
daily_routine: scouting new stands of scrub and tamarisk for cutting
hauling cut wood back along the kiln paths
marking safe versus unstable ground near the Old Canal Bed
listening to Bran's lessons on reading a grove's health
trading gossip with Kiri while resting at the herding fence line
occasionally wandering farther than his route requires

goals.public_goal: Learn the kiln-fuel trade well enough to scout independently
goals.hidden_goal: Find out what lies at the far end of the Old Canal Bed that Bran won't discuss
goals.deep_goal: Prove that his curiosity is worth more to the town than his caution

beliefs: The Old Canal Bed is more interesting than dangerous
Adults hide things from the young by calling them dangerous instead of explaining
The groves remember more about the Turning than the elders admit
Being fast and curious matters as much as being careful
Something is buried in the dried canal silt, and it isn't just old pottery
